summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new 'Skema Harga & Kategori Jasa Servis' feature. All 27 assertions across 3 scenarios passed: (1) Admin master data CRUD in Settings — 7 seed categories + 18 seed items verified; category & item create/edit/delete flows worked; (2) End-to-end repair ticket flow — Add from catalog (Layar/LCD → Ganti LCD Original auto-fill 850k, edited to 800k), second row (Baterai → Standar auto-fill 250k), Custom row (Reset Pola HP 100k), total = 1.150.000; Estimasi Biaya Jasa field auto-disabled & synced to 1.150.000; Trash on Baterai row → total = 900.000; ticket created successfully; RepairDetail shows 'Rincian Jasa Servis' with per-line breakdown + Custom badge + total 900.000; Bill summary Biaya Jasa = 900.000; Invoice renders per-line jasa (Ganti LCD Original Rp 800.000 + Reset Pola HP Custom Rp 100.000) rather than a single generic 'Jasa Servis' line; (3) Teknisi role — Master Data section correctly hidden on Settings, RepairNew still fully accessible with 7 categories in picker (read-only to catalog).
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (non-blocking) React warning: `value` prop on <select> should not be null — originates from ItemModal in ServiceCatalogSection.jsx line 237-242 when form.category_id is undefined (mostly during 'Kategori Baru' flow flash before useEffect syncs). Fix: default form.category_id to '' in initial state and useEffect fallback (`category_id: categoryId || ''`).

The `<span>` inside `<option>` hydration warning observed in RepairNew is caused by the Emergent visual-editor instrumentation on dynamic <option> children, NOT by app code — safe to ignore in preview.
ServicePicker.addRow auto-selects the first category (categories[0]) but leaves item_id empty. Cosmetic: users may be surprised that a category is preselected — acceptable UX, no action needed.
Consider adding data-testid to repair detail 'Biaya Jasa' amount cell (currently only bill-total/bill-balance have testids) for stronger regression coverage — nice-to-have.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_ data (Test Kategori Playwright, Test Jasa QA) was created and deleted within tests. A repair ticket KK-2609-001 with services_json was left in localStorage as by-product of E2E flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature complete & working end-to-end in LOCAL data mode. Key data-testids: section-service-catalog, btn-new-service-category, cat-name-input, btn-save-cat, btn-add-item-{catId}, item-name-input, item-price-input, btn-save-item, service-picker, btn-add-service-row, btn-add-service-custom, service-row-{n}-category, service-row-{n}-item, service-row-{n}-price, service-row-{n}-custom-name, service-row-{n}-remove, service-picker-total, repair-service-fee (auto-disabled when picker has rows), services-section (RepairDetail read-only breakdown), bill-summary. Invoice at /repairs/:id/invoice renders per-line jasa from services_json (fallback to legacy service_fee if absent).
